title: PrimeLister vs List Perfectly 2026: Which is Better?
summary: PrimeLister vs List Perfectly: compare pricing, essential features, and mobile access to find the right crosslisting app for your reselling business.
body_markdown:
When it comes to PrimeLister vs List Perfectly


**,** both Chrome extension crosslisting tools built for resellers, but List Perfectly is better with catalog depth while PrimeLister wins on platform-specific automation. That being said, neither beats a cloud-based option like Vendoo on things like pricing transparency or mobile access.


## Main Takeaways


- PrimeLister's automation bots (Poshmark, eBay, Depop) work well individually, but stacking them with Crosslisting Pro runs close to $105/mo.


- List Perfectly is strong for catalog and inventory management, but auto-delisting is locked behind the $99/mo Pro Plus plan.


- Both PrimeLister and List Perfectly are Chrome extensions, so crosslisting depends on your browser staying open and your internet staying stable.


- Neither tool offers a true native mobile app, which limits sellers who source and list on the go.


- Vendoo includes instant auto-delisting on all plans and a fully featured mobile app, without requiring a premium upgrade.


- Vendoo's pricing scales with actual listing volume instead of charging a flat rate or requiring stacked subscriptions.


## PrimeLister: Strengths and Weaknesses


PrimeLister has built a reputation for platform-specific automation, particularly for Poshmark sellers, but understanding its full 2026 pricing structure is crucial before pulling out your credit card. Here's what actually works well, and where the costs add up.


### **The Bot Advantage**


PrimeLister's biggest strength is its platform-specific automation bots. Poshmark’s bot, for example: for $25/mo, it can run your Poshmark closet on autopilot, handling shares, follows, and sending offers to likers so the closet stays active without you manually touching it all day.


PrimeLister also offers separate automation bots for eBay ($15/mo) and Depop ($15/mo), so sellers active on those platforms get the same kind of hands-off automation built specifically for how each marketplace works.


Here’s what the bots include:


- **Poshmark bot:** auto-sharing to followers and parties, sending bulk offers to likers, auto follow/unfollow, and relisting items from scratch


- **eBay bot:** unlimited auto-recreate listings and unlimited automatic offers sent to watchers


- **Depop bot:** unlimited auto-relisting and automatic offers sent to users who liked an item


### **Segmented Pricing**


Pricing is where things get tricky. PrimeLister doesn't sell one plan with everything in it. The Poshmark bot, the eBay bot, the Depop bot, and the actual Crosslisting Pro tool are all billed as separate subscriptions, which is a little tedious and can get pricey:


- Poshmark Automation: $25/mo


- eBay Automation: $15/mo


- Depop Automation: $15/mo


- Crosslisting Pro (the tool that actually posts across platforms): $49.99/mo


So if you want the Poshmark bot, the eBay bot, the Depop bot, and Crosslisting Pro, you're stacking all four, which puts you close to $105/mo to get all the available features.


### **The "Form-Filling" Problem**


Because PrimeLister runs as a Chrome extension rather than in the cloud, crosslisting happens by rapidly opening browser tabs and typing your listing data into each marketplace's own form, one at a time.


That means your computer has to stay open and connected the whole time it's working. If your internet lags or the browser crashes, the crosslisting fails and you're left checking which listings actually went through.


## List Perfectly: Strengths and Weaknesses


List Perfectly has been well known in the reselling community for years, and its cataloging features are one of the best. But one of the most useful automations, auto-delisting, is only included with a higher tiered, more expensive plan.


### **Catalog Management**


List Perfectly's biggest strength is catalog management. It works like a centralized hub where you can draft, store, and organize thousands of listings in one place, which makes it a solid fit for sellers who need to keep a huge, growing inventory organized.


### **The $99 Auto-Delist Paywall**


This is the biggest pain point for 2026 sellers. List Perfectly’s lower tiers don’t include automatic sale detection, something that’s a pretty standard need for any reseller who is selling on multiple platforms. That means, unless you’re paying for their $99/mo tier, you're manually marking items sold and pulling them off other marketplaces yourself. Here's what each tier actually gets you:


- **Simple ($29/mo):** crosslist to all marketplaces, unlimited templates, 25 background removals, AI Listing Assistant, Mark Sold, barcode scanning, mobile friendly. No bulk crosslisting, no analytics, no auto-delisting, no Poshmark sharing.


- **Business ($49/mo):** adds bulk crosslisting, Sales Analytics, and CSV download. Still no auto-delist, no Poshmark sharing.


- **Pro ($69/mo):** adds Pro Description Builder, Sales Detection, and Poshmark Sharing Tools. Still no true auto-delist.


- **Pro Plus ($99+/mo):** the only tier with Auto Delist, plus Sub Accounts and full Poshmark Automation.


To get auto-delisting so you can avoid double-selling without having to stop what you’re doing to delist an item anytime it sells on another platform, you have to upgrade all the way to the top tier.


### **Desktop Dependency**


List Perfectly has a basic mobile interface, but it's not a true native mobile app that works independently of their Chrome extension.


Through the mobile web view, you can browse your inventory and make small edits, but bulk actions, Poshmark sharing, and crosslisting still require the desktop extension. That keeps sellers stuck at home on their computers for most of the features, which is a problem if you source and list on the go and want to draft or crosslist directly from your phone.

## The Cloud Advantage: Why Sellers Choose Vendoo


For sellers tired of extensions that mean watching tabs open and hoping nothing crashes, Vendoo offers a better way to crosslist. It's cloud-based and built for workflow efficiency and mobile freedom instead of stacking different automation add-ons onto software that was never meant to truly run your whole reselling business.


### **Leaving the Browser Behind**


The core difference between PrimeLister, List Perfectly, and Vendoo comes down to how they actually work. PrimeLister and List Perfectly are Chrome extensions, so crosslisting means the tool has to open tabs and type your listing data into each marketplace one at a time. Vendoo skips that process entirely and can work quietly in the background, which is also how it's able to support 10 marketplaces without slowing down or depending on your browser staying open.


### **Accessible Auto-Delisting**


Vendoo includes instant Sale Detection on every plan, no upgrades needed. The second an item sells, it comes down from your other listings automatically, so double-selling isn't something you have to think about or manage manually. It just works in the background from the moment you start using the tool.


### **True Mobile Freedom**


Modern resellers are sourcing at thrift stores, estate sales, and the bins, not sitting at a computer all day. Vendoo's fully featured mobile app, available on both iOS and Android, lets you draft listings, snap and edit photos with the in-app photo editor, remove backgrounds, and crosslist right from your phone.


### **Transparent Volume Pricing**


Vendoo scales with the seller instead of charging a flat rate regardless of volume. Plans start at a truly affordable $12.49/mo, and you upgrade as your business grows, which keeps it affordable whether you're just starting out or flipping full-time.


## Conclusion


PrimeLister and List Perfectly both do the job, but the costs catch up with you eventually. PrimeLister's bots work well, but stack them with Crosslisting Pro and you're looking at close to $105/mo. List Perfectly's catalog tools are solid, but auto-delisting sits behind a $99/mo paywall, so on the lower tiers you're still pulling sold items by hand. Both are also Chrome extensions, so your listings depend on your browser staying open and your wifi cooperating.


Vendoo just skips all of that. Auto-delisting comes standard, the mobile app lets you list from anywhere, and pricing scales with your inventory instead of stacking subscriptions on top of each other. If you want crosslisting that actually works without extra fees or babysitting your laptop, Vendoo has a 14 day free trial so you can try it out for yourself.


## FAQs


### Is PrimeLister cheaper than List Perfectly?


It depends on what you need. PrimeLister's Crosslisting Pro alone is $49.99/mo, cheaper than List Perfectly's $69 Pro plan. But if you also need Poshmark, eBay, or Depop automation, stacking PrimeLister's separate bots pushes the total close to $105/mo.


### Do PrimeLister and List Perfectly have mobile apps?


No. Both run as Chrome extensions and require a desktop browser to work. List Perfectly offers a basic mobile web view, but it's not a true native app. Neither tool lets you draft, edit, or crosslist listings from your phone the way a cloud-based app can.


### Which crosslisting app automatically removes sold items?


Vendoo includes automatic sale detection on its plans, removing sold items from other marketplaces instantly. List Perfectly only offers this on its $99/mo Pro Plus plan. PrimeLister's auto-delisting runs through its Crosslisting Pro tool but is at risk for errors since it depends on browser tabs staying open.


### What is the best alternative to PrimeLister and List Perfectly?


Vendoo is the strongest alternative for sellers who want to avoid Chrome extension limitations. It's cloud-based, includes a native mobile app, offers instant auto-delisting on all plans, and scales pricing to actual listing volume instead of charging flat or stacked subscription fees.
